about: The history of the API version (API.4). One row per version, oldest first; the newest row's version is planetgen.api.version.API_VERSION. A PR that raises API_VERSION adds its row here with "first_release": null and "pending": true and a line "api-version: changed" in its note; the stamp names the release. docs/reference/api-compatibility.md is built from this file by scripts/build_api_compatibility.py.

versions.summary: The first numbered version: every /api answer carries it in the X-PlanetGen-API-Version header and /api/health reports it.
Sectors, systems and phenomena are named by their object ID, not by their database row number.
changes: id, sector_id and ref fields of sector, system and phenomenon answers carry the printed object ID (0008000000-4000000-000)
URLs /api/systems/<id>, /api/sectors/<id>, /api/phenomena/<type>/<id>, /api/nebulae/<id>/...
from, to and course references such as system:0008000000-4000000-000
a row number in any of these is refused (404)

versions.summary: Stars, planets, moons, asteroid belts, comets and facilities are named by their object ID too.
changes: fields id, star_id, planet_id, moon_id, belt_id, comet_id, host_id and homeworld_planet_id; <kind>:<ID> references
URLs /api/planets/<id>, /api/moons/<id>/class, /api/facilities/<id>
POST /api/facilities and GET /api/facilities/orbit take the host's ID as host_id

versions.summary: The galaxy settings files are gone.
changes: GET /api/admin/galaxy-settings removed
GET /api/admin/galaxy-settings/<name> removed

versions.summary: A system's description is a document built from stored data, not a table of paragraphs.
changes: GET /api/systems/<uid>/sections removed

versions.summary: The work queue endpoints answer runs held in Redis, not job trees.
changes: GET /api/admin/work and GET /api/admin/work/<id> return runs with their stage, units and time left; <id> is a run id
POST /api/admin/work/<id>/control takes cancel or clear (pause and resume of a node are gone)
POST /api/admin/work/<id>/delete and clear-finished delete runs
GET /api/admin/work/<id>/log is new
POST /api/admin/work/lease/clear removed

versions.summary: Every sector address is shell, band and wedge, where it was ring, layer and slot.
changes: request parameters shell, band and wedge; answers shell_index, band_index and wedge_index (were ring, layer, slot; ring_index, layer_index, ring_slot_index)
no route that takes the old names is kept

versions.summary: The Galaxy Map reads its data by sector-block node; the cube tiles are gone.
changes: GET /api/galaxy/tiles removed; GET /api/galaxy/nodes is the map's data
GET /api/galaxy/changes answers nodes, no longer tiles

versions.summary: A star, planet or moon of a system scene carries a look record, not a colour.
changes: GET /api/systems/<id>/scene: stars, planets and moons have look (the body look record, which holds the color and what the painters need) and no color; a comet keeps color
